sn22.35:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.35:1.3: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu,
sn22.35:1.4: yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.35:1.5: yaṃ kho bhikkhu, anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati,
sn22.35:1.6: yaṃ nānuseti, na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti.
sn22.35:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti?
sn22.35:2.2: rūpaṃ ce bhante, anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.3: vedanaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.4: saññaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.5: saṅkhāre ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.6: viññāṇaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.7: rūpaṃ ce bhante, nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.8: vedanaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati,
sn22.35:2.9: saññaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.11: nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati. viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:2.12: imassa khohaṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.35:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.35:3.3: rūpaṃ ce bhikkhu, anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.7: …pe… viññāṇaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.8: rūpaṃ ce bhikkhu, nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.12: …pe… viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn22.35:3.13: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
sn22.35:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn22.35:5.1: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn22.35:5.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn22.35:5.3: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
